backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor managing users, attendance records, permissions, and attendance percentage calculations with authorization checks.
backend/validation.mo: Validation utilities that enforce name rules including length, allowed characters, and reserved-word checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature report listing theme-related changes, affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing responsibilities of various frontend files across domain, state, components, and theme logic.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light and dark design tokens with dark-mode variables and shared base styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML document with solid dark background to prevent flash and root mount for the React app.
frontend/index.ts: Note indicating FCM and push notifications are unsupported in this build.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application managing routing, theme application, profile sync, attendance workflows, and cleanup of service workers and caches.
frontend/src/backup/backupIO.ts: Backup import/export utilities that validate and migrate stored app state including theme normalization.
frontend/src/backup/backupSchema.ts: Defines backup data structure, validation, and migration logic including theme normalization and default field merging for restores.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Bunkab: Displays bunkable class count with loading/error states and status-based styling using data from useBunkableClasses.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Circul: Implements an animated circular progress SVG with dynamic stroke offset and optional percentage label.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Subjec: Renders a subject attendance card with stats, streak/trend badges, and a circular progress indicator.
Provides the main app layout with optional header/footer and spacing to avoid bottom navigation overlap.
frontend/src/components/markToday/MarkTo: Bottom sheet for marking today's classes, initializing scheduled classes and saving events with duplicate and loading guards.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Botto: Creates a 5‑tab bottom navigation bar with active-state styling and icons.
frontend/src/components/pastAttendance/M: Enables marking or editing past attendance with date selection, schedule lookup, and date‑scoped save handling.
frontend/src/components/settings/AboutCa: Displays app name, version, description, founder info, and copyright.
frontend/src/components/settings/BackupR: Provides backup export/import with file selection and a confirmation dialog for restoring data.
frontend/src/components/settings/LogoutC: Offers a logout button with a confirmation dialog and resilient logout handling.
frontend/src/components/settings/Notific: Manages browser notification settings, permission requests, category toggles, and test notifications.
frontend/src/components/settings/Profile: Lets users edit, validate, and save their display name with edit/save/cancel flow.
frontend/src/components/settings/TargetP: Controls target attendance percentage using a slider and numeric input.
frontend/src/components/settings/ThemeSe: Allows choosing between predefined color theme variants.
frontend/src/components/subjects/Confirm: Reusable confirmation dialog for destructive actions with customizable text.
frontend/src/components/subjects/Subject: Dropdown menu offering edit, reset, and delete actions for a subject.
Dialog for creating or editing subjects with validation and duplicate name checks.
frontend/src/components/system/ErrorBoun: React error boundary that classifies auth errors and shows session‑expired or generic reload UI.
frontend/src/components/system/NonBlocki: Hook-based component that shows a toast for non-blocking errors and dismisses via callback.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceCalculatio: Pure utilities for computing attendance stats, safe bunk counts, required classes, insights, and streaks.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceReducer.ts: Reducer handling subjects, events, timetable, exchanges, daily attendance upserts, and full state restoration.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceTypes.ts: Defines core attendance domain types including events, subjects, timetable slots, settings, user profiles, and default state.
frontend/src/domain/premiumInsights.ts: Provides prediction, trend direction, and streak-based motivational messaging for premium insights.
frontend/src/domain/scheduleForDate.ts: Computes scheduled classes for a date by combining timetable slots and exchange overrides.
frontend/src/domain/streakMilestones.ts: Utility functions for calculating day streaks and determining milestone awards.
Validates display names with length checks and character rules, returning normalized results.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates a backend actor tied to the current Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthRecovery.ts: Provides logout and error-recovery helpers that clear app state, caches, and identity on auth failures.
frontend/src/hooks/useBunkableClasses.ts: Fetches attendance requirements and computes maximum bunkable classes using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailyAttendanceRem: Schedules daily checks after 7 PM to send an attendance reminder notification if today's attendance is unmarked.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity login state, stored identities, and exposes login/clear functions via context.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind styles, theme variables, dark mode rules, animations, and premium UI components.
frontend/src/lib/attendanceConflictHandl: Maps backend attendance errors to user-friendly messages and detects conflicts or logout-requiring errors.
frontend/src/lib/authErrorHandling.ts: Classifies authorization-related errors into safe user messages and identifies when logout is required.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Provides branding constants and theme-agnostic logo asset selectors for the app.
frontend/src/lib/platform.ts: Detects whether the runtime platform is Android using userAgentData or userAgent.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Provides class merging, ID generation, local date formatting, date comparison helpers, and subject color selection utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity context providers.
frontend/src/notifications/localNotifica: Generates formatted notification titles and messages for class marking actions.
frontend/src/notifications/notificationL: Exports static text explaining notification limitations and permission-related messages.
frontend/src/notifications/notifications: Implements a wrapper around the browser Notifications API with support checks, permission handling, and sending notifications.
frontend/src/notifications/reminderFailu: Provides rate-limited, user-friendly error messages for reminder notification failures.
frontend/src/pages/HomeDashboardPage.tsx: Renders the main dashboard, handles milestones, notifications, and subject interactions with backend integration.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Implements a simple name-based login form with validation and async submission.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Renders settings controls including profile updates, logout flow, notifications, theme, and backups.
frontend/src/pages/StatsPage.tsx: Renders a statistics dashboard showing overall attendance percentage with visual progress and breakdown cards. Pulls data from store and displays attended, missed, and cancelled totals.
frontend/src/pages/SubjectDetailsPage.ts: Shows detailed stats and actions for a single subject, including attendance breakdown, safe bunk and required-to-target calculations. Supports editing, resetting, and deleting subjects.
frontend/src/pages/TimetablePage.tsx: Displays and edits a weekly timetable grid where subjects can be assigned to time slots. Supports toggling edit mode and updating timetable slots via the store.
frontend/src/rank/ConfettiBurst.tsx: Generates a lightweight animated confetti overlay using randomly generated particle positions and timings. Used for celebratory effects such as top-rank achievements.
frontend/src/rank/rankApi.ts: Legacy compatibility API that proxies ranking fetch and submit calls through RankingService.
frontend/src/rank/RankBadge.tsx: Renders visual rank badges with special designs for ranks 1–3 and gradient numeric badges for all other ranks. Uses lucide icons for trophy-style visuals.
frontend/src/rank/rankCache.ts: LocalStorage-based cache utilities for saving, loading, and clearing weekly ranking data.
frontend/src/rank/RankingModel.ts: Defines ranking UI types and mapping utilities to convert backend ranking data into UI-friendly structures. Includes validation helpers for ranking entries.
frontend/src/rank/RankingRepository.ts: Provides methods to fetch paginated or full leaderboard data from the backend and submit user points. Handles rank numbering and backend communication errors.
frontend/src/rank/RankingScreen.tsx: Main ranking UI component with polling, error handling, auto-scroll, confetti, and guarded backend fetches.
frontend/src/rank/RankingService.ts: Service layer wrapping repository calls with cache fallback, auth error handling, and page fetching.
frontend/src/rank/RankPage.tsx: Entry wrapper that passes actor, user identity, and profile info into the RankingScreen. Connects ranking UI to global app state and authentication.
frontend/src/state/appStore.tsx: React Context store managing global app state with persistence, loading, and reset-aware saving.
frontend/src/state/persistence.ts: IndexedDB-backed state loader/saver with validation, normalization, and backward-compatible merging.
frontend/src/storage/indexedDbClient.ts: IndexedDB client handling app state read/write/clear operations via a simple object store.
frontend/src/theme/themeManager.ts: Theme utilities enforcing permanent dark mode and applying theme variants.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters across query and hash routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, custom colors, animations, shadows, and plugins including typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: JSON state file describing project version, feature summary, architectural notes, and known issues for the BunkPro app.
